text.tspan: 4 KB Paging over 64 KB Windows Granularity
Maps 64 MiB pgalloc.MemoryFile arenas once via
WHvMapGpaRange; guest page tables enforce 4 KB R/W/X
amd64 Trap Path (stubgen_x86.go)
Guest Ring-3 SYSCALL -> Ring-0 MSR_LSTAR ->
spills GPRs to 4 KB CommPage -> HLT exits vCPU
arm64 Trap Path (stubgen_a64.go)
Guest EL0 SVC #0 -> EL1 vectors -> spills X0..X8
to CommPage -> unbacked GPA-0 load exits to Sentry
Resume Path
Go Sentry writes return registers to CommPage ->
resumes vCPU -> Ring-0 / EL1 reloads -> SYSRETQ / ERET
Two-Stage MMU (4 KB Guest over 16 KB XNU Host)
Stage-2 (hv_vm_map) maps 1 GiB chunks at 16 KB;
Stage-1 (TTBR0_EL1, TG0=4KB) enforces 4 KB R-X / RW-
Trap Path (bluepill_arm64.go)
Guest EL0 SVC #0 or Page Fault -> EL1 VBAR_EL1 ->
spills X0..X8, SP_EL0, ELR_EL1 to 4 KB CommPage -> HVC #0
Resume Path
hv_vcpu_run returns to locked Go thread -> Sentry
services syscall -> updates CommPage -> ERET to EL0
Hardware CR3 / TTBR0 Isolation
Runs guest code in isolated 1 KB stub subprocesses
(stubimage_xplat.go) under Low-Integrity Token + JobObject
In-Place Binary Patcher
Replaces 2-byte syscall (0f 05) with jmp rel32 (or CC 90)
on amd64, and svc #0 with B island jump (or brk) on arm64
Fast-Path Shared Memory IPC
Island spills registers to winSysmsg page -> syncs via
WaitOnAddress / WakeByAddressSingle (DebugObject on fault)
Guest Thread Fast Path (sysmsg)
Guest syscalls trap via SECCOMP_RET_TRAP (SIGSYS) ->
binary-patches site with jmp rel32 to sysmsg + SYS_FUTEX
Stub syscallThread (_RUN_SECCOMP_LOOP = 6)
Address-space syscalls (mmap/munmap/clone) wake stub
via SECCOMP_RET_USER_NOTIF listener FD
Nested Fallback Mode (_RUN_SYSCALL_LOOP = 5, PR #71)
When outer sandbox holds NEW_LISTENER (EBUSY), stub
syscallThread switches to shared-memory SYS_FUTEX loop
